item.title: Iran, proxy militias threaten US universities in Lebanon as Americans urged to flee now
item.summary: Iran and its proxy militias have threatened universities in Lebanon, U.S. officials say, and the State Department warned Americans to depart immediately.

item.title: Iran Guards recruiting children as young as 12, putting them on front lines of war
item.summary: Human Rights Watch and Amnesty International report Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps is recruiting children as young as 12 into military-linked combat and patrol roles.

item.title: Iran's tallest bridge collapses after reported US airstrikes; Iran threatens American allies in retaliation
item.summary: Iran's biggest bridge near Tehran crashes down after reported U.S. airstrikes as Trump presses the regime to make a deal before escalation.

item.title: Jewish communities on high alert as Passover begins amid rising security threats nationwide
item.summary: Jewish communities face a heightened security threat this Passover, with NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch warning of an elevated alert as antisemitic attacks rise across the U.S.

item.title: Iran regime uses war to mask 'brutal' execution surge against political opponents
item.summary: A State Department spokesperson called Iran's executions "barbaric" as the United Nations and activists group report the regime is using the death penalty to crush dissent.

item.title: Israeli paramedic delivers baby, rushes it to bomb shelter during Iran attack
item.summary: Israeli paramedic Dr. Gal Rosen delivered a baby in Tel Aviv, then raced to a bomb shelter with the newborn as Iron Dome missile sirens blared overhead.

item.title: Iran's ceasefire push may be a 'cycle of deception,' analysts warn as shadowy figure gains power
item.summary: Iran's shadowy Ahmad Vahidi, a former Quds Force commander linked to deadly bombings abroad, is now more dominant than Iran's president or Khamenei's son, experts warn.

item.title: Turkey’s NATO role under scrutiny amid new report on Hamas, Muslim Brotherhood ties
item.summary: A new Foundation for Defense of Democracies report alleges Turkey under Erdogan has shifted toward Islamist movements, raising NATO alliance concerns ahead of a July summit in Ankara, Turkey.

item.title: Israel approves sweeping death penalty legislation targeting terrorism, EU condemns move
item.summary: Israel's Knesset voted to mandate the death penalty for terrorists convicted of deadly attacks, a shift lawmakers say was driven by the horrors of the Oct. 7 massacre.

item.title: Exclusive: Sara Netanyahu warns of surging antisemitism and importance of Jewish-Christian alliance
item.summary: Sara Netanyahu wrapped up a four-day Washington visit at the invitation of the first lady Melania Trump focused on tech and education over the backdrop of the Iran war and rising antisemitism.
